name: Furrow
tagline: An AI farm advisor in your messaging app that turns voice notes and photos into structured logs and advice.
problem: Farm record-keeping and compliance are messy and time-consuming.
solution: Farmers send text, voice or photos by message; the system transcribes, logs entries with chemical-safety checks and returns actionable advice, using several model providers.
demo_moment: Team-described: send a voice note and receive a structured log entry.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Bitcamp Hack - Bitcamp” among 223 submissions.
Lives in a channel farmers already use.

lessons: Meet field workers in their messaging app.
